text:
deploy-bot: Promotion to production for release v1.12.0 blocked — postsubmit pipeline failed on staging. See run: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/4589 :warning:

maria: ugh. which stage? logs?

ci-bot: failed stage: staging-postsubmit-e2e (step: integration-tests)
Log excerpt:
```
FAIL: tests/integration/test_migrations.py::TestMigrations::test_live_migration_timeout
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"tests/integration/test_migrations.py\", line 48, in test_live_migration_timeout
    wait_for_migration(timeout=120)
TimeoutError: migration did not complete in 120s
```

ken: also seeing an upstream cache artifact mismatch during the build step earlier: "artifact digest mismatch for //services/auth:wheel (expected 7f3a9, got 2b8c1)". Appears remote cache returned stale blob and the promotion job aborted.

olivia: hmm that digest mismatch smells like partially uploaded artifact + concurrent garbage-collection. If we re-run the job it *may* hit the correct cache, but we should avoid a blind retry during change window.

maria: can we pin the auth wheel to the last-green commit and rerun just the promote job? that would avoid re-building everything.

devops: temporary plan: hold promotion, pin to commit f2d4a1 (last green), and run a targeted pipeline for staging promote. If that passes we can proceed with canary promote during the 16:00-18:00 change window. I will add a manual hold label.

release-manager-bot: Release hold placed by @devops — reason: postsubmit failure (e2e timeout) + artifact cache digest conflict. Approvers requested: @maria, @ken.

ken: quick repro steps I ran locally:
```
# fetch artifacts from remote cache
bazel fetch //services/auth:wheel
# inspect remote digest
bazel cquery --output=starlark --starlark:expr='target.digest' //services/auth:wheel
```
I can try an explicit re-upload of the correct wheel to the remote cache if CI team gives go-ahead.

olivia: alternative temporary mitigation: switch promote to use the fallback build artifact in s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/last-green/services/auth/wheel.whl and skip remote cache lookup for that target. Need a small promote config change (+1 to canary risk).

maria: prefer the pin + targeted run. ken can re-upload as fallback, devops schedule the targeted run for 15:10 to give us time to triage. If it passes, update release notes to call out the pinned artifact and include a postmortem item about cache GC.

devops: scheduled targeted promote job at 15:10. Holding global promote until we verify staging canary at 16:00. Also opened ticket INFRA-3247 to audit remote cache GC and upload race.

maria: thanks. will prepare a short release-note blurb and tag infra for the postmortem. :thumbsup:

ken: I'll be on standby to force-upload the wheel if the targeted run still pulls the wrong digest.

deploy-bot: Noted. Current state: promotion blocked, hold label present, targeted run scheduled. Notifications will go out on status change.
